scientific.integrity: The final claim separates the prior-covered qualitative zero-entropy mechanism from the new exact boundary tail identity and explicit finite-horizon tail-product bound. No computational experiment is used.
scientific.limitations: The quantitative bound is stated for equal-arc partitions; arbitrary finite partitions are handled qualitatively by approximation. No optimality of the cube-root exponent and no sequence-independent entropy-decay rate are claimed.

title: Exact boundary tail law and quantitative zero entropy for the summable Blaschke sequence
